Subject: Evaluation playbook — evidence and timeline (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo and the platform walkthrough yesterday. We had a quick alignment call on our side and want to lock the final-mile plan so procurement can tee up the PO next week. Key asks from Lakeside: 

- A mutual action plan (high-level milestones + owners) that ties SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ responses, and DPA redline delivery into a single close timeline.
- Estimated delivery dates for SOC 2 artifacts we flagged (CC6.1, Logging, and Monitoring evidence).
- Confirm whether Redwood can accept our DPA signature flow and provide a marked-up redline by Nov 3.
- Clarify the planned data retention/archival default and any options for a 7-year retention carveout (we need this for audit).

Attached is the SIG spreadsheet we completed this morning and a copy of our standard DPA. Can you confirm who on your side will drive the legal redline vs. the security evidence? Also, what acceptance criteria will your team require to mark the security gate as complete?

Appreciate a short MAP (bullet list) and expected delivery cadence by end of week.

Best,
Sarah Li
Head of Vendor Risk, Lakeside Bank

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. Sending a concise MAP below and calling out owners for each security/compliance gate. We'll follow up with a one-page checklist for procurement.

Mutual Action Plan (high-level) — Lakeside Bank / Redwood Inference
1) DPA redline and legal signoff — owner: marissa_cole (Redwood legal ops support) — target: 2026-11-03 (Marissa to produce redline & comment matrix).
2) SIG/CAIQ finalization — owner: stephanie_nguyen + Lakeside SME — target: 2026-11-02 (we'll validate your completed sheet; we may add clarifying notes).
3) SOC 2 evidence handoff (snapshot + supporting artifacts) — owner: ben_carter (Redwood Security) — staged delivery: core artifacts by 2026-11-09, follow-up logs & evidence by 2026-11-16.
4) Data retention appendix (options + implementation plan) — owner: stephanie_nguyen / Lakeside legal — draft by 2026-11-05; final option to be included in DPA as Annex A.
5) Acceptance check and final signoff (security gate closed) — owner: Lakeside Risk & Redwood Security — target: 2026-11-18.

Acceptance criteria (security gate) — short list:
- SOC 2 snapshot (PDF) + list of control owners and evidence locations.
- Completed SIG spreadsheet with clarifying notes where we need a follow-up.
- DPA executed OR mutually accepted redline + timeline for final signature.
- Data retention annex agreed (minimum retention + any carveouts documented).

Ben, can you confirm the SOC 2 artifact timeline above? Marissa — can you and I coordinate the DPA redline and share as a single marked-up file with Lakeside Legal?

I'll open a shared Drive folder and upload the acceptance checklist and SIG QA notes today.

Thanks — Stephanie
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

SOC 2 artifact plan (owner: ben_carter)
- 2026-11-09: SOC 2 snapshot PDF (2025 audit) + control matrix (mapping to CC criteria) — attachment: SOC2-snapshot-2025.pdf.
- 2026-11-12: Endpoint & host inventory export + evidence pointers (s3://redwood-evidence/DEAL-7429/).
- 2026-11-16: Retention policy + log retention proof (sample logs showing retention policy in action).

Notes / clarifications:

- If Lakeside needs a dedicated attestation call with our security lead, I can join — suggest week of Nov 9 for a 30-min walkthrough.

Action items for Lakeside (to close SOC2 gate):
1) Confirm whether redacted samples meet your reviewers' needs or whether you require a sandbox account for hands-on verification.
2) Share any templated evidence checklists your risk team will use so we can align deliverables.

Stephanie / Marissa / Ben — thanks for the MAP and timelines. Lakeside Legal has a couple of quick asks after a first pass on the redline: 

1) We can accept the 2-tier retention proposal pending one change — archival encryption key custody language (we require a KMS escrow option for the 7-year carveout).
2) For SOC 2 evidence, redacted logs + attestation call should be sufficient. Please send dates for the week of Nov 9.
3) SIG clarifications: a few rows in your answers need context (we'll highlight in the spreadsheet).

If you can share the consolidated DPA redline link and the Drive checklist by EOD Monday (Nov 8) we'll route to procurement and legal for signature. Otherwise, this timeline looks achievable and prefer to aim for the Nov 18 acceptance date.

Next steps we hear:
- Marissa: update DPA with KMS escrow language and post link to DocuSign.
- Ben: propose two possible slots for the SOC 2 walkthrough (Nov 10 or Nov 12).
- Stephanie: post consolidated MAP + acceptance checklist to shared Drive.
